name: Suzuki RE5 Rotary
engine: 497 cc liquid-cooled single-rotor Wankel engine, two-stage carb, oil injection for the rotor
intro: Suzuki's rotary bike. A Wankel engine with its own oiling, cooling and ignition quirks. Go slow and find a specialist.

B: The rotor seals get their oil from a pump fed by a separate tank. Check that system works before you run the engine.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
